findings.evidence: KostantForm.lean:66-68 (`noncomputable local instance kostantFormModuleNNRat`); mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/Binomial.lean:277 `noncomputable instance {R} [AddCommMonoid R] [Module ℚ≥0 R] [Pow R ℕ] : BinomialRing R`; `grep -rn "ℚ≥0" TauCeti` returns only these two lines, so no earlier TauCeti file provides it.
findings.fix: Move it to an earlier general file — e.g. next to `TauCeti.Associative.dividedPower` in `TauCeti/RingTheory/DividedPowers/Associative.lean` (already imported here), or a dedicated general module — stated for an arbitrary `[AddCommMonoid A] [Module ℚ A]` (or ℚ-algebra), exported rather than `local`, and rename off the `kostantForm` prefix.
findings.issue: `kostantFormModuleNNRat : Module ℚ≥0 (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℚ L) := Module.compHom _ (algebraMap ℚ≥0 ℚ)` is a general fact about any ℚ-module/ℚ-algebra, with no Lie or Kostant content, yet it is placed in this file, specialized to the enveloping algebra, and marked `local` so it does not escape. It is the only route to `BinomialRing` (mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/Binomial.lean:277 requires `[Module ℚ≥0 R]`; Mathlib has no ℚ-algebra → ℚ≥0-module instance — grep shows only `subsingleton_nnrat_module` and the `DivisibleHull` instance). Consequence: `kostantCartanGenerators`, `choose_mem_kostantForm` and the `Ring.choose` half of `kostantForm_le_iff` are exported, but a downstream Chevalley file cannot write `Ring.choose (ι ℚ (h i)) n` without re-declaring the instance itself.

summary: File location and imports are correct, but the general `Module ℚ≥0` instance that makes `Ring.choose` elaborate is declared as a Kostant-specific `local instance` in this file instead of living in an earlier general file, so the exported Cartan-generator API cannot be stated downstream.
